title: AMPLIFY INITIATIVE: BUILDING A LOCALIZED DATA PLATFORM FOR GLOBALIZED AI

bias_targets.methodology: Co-creation of annotated multilingual adversarial queries by local domain experts to evaluate large language models on their awareness of unique cultural practices, local knowledge, and regional norms.
Co-creation of annotated adversarial queries by domain experts targeting gendered stereotypes and societal expectations, such as stigmas surrounding men's mental health and emasculation.

Co-creation of annotated adversarial queries by domain experts to identify negative stereotypes, representational blind spots, and discriminatory themes associated with specific African ethnic groups and tribes.

Co-creation of annotated adversarial queries by domain experts evaluating models on issues of physical accessibility, social inclusion, and societal prejudices regarding individuals with physical or learning disabilities.
Co-creation of annotated adversarial queries by domain experts exploring misinformation, stigma, and discrimination related to specific health conditions and statuses (e.g., HIV/AIDS, albinism).
Co-creation of annotated adversarial queries by domain experts assessing representation, public interest, and stereotypes regarding traditional religious practices and beliefs.
